SOCIAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #20
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Historic Built Environments is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Historic Built Environments with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Historic Built Environments.
   C. Say Historic Built Environments never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Historic Built Environments as rumours only.

2. Which statement about Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa.
   C. Treat Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa as rumours only.
   D. Say Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.

3. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Measure rainfall only
   B. Replace the compass rose
   C. Name the president
   D. Explain symbols used on a map

4. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nakuru
   B. Kisumu
   C. Mombasa
   D. Nairobi

5. Which statement about Climatic regions in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Climatic regions in Eastern Africa as rumours only.
   B. Say Climatic regions in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Climatic regions in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Climatic regions in Eastern Africa.

6. Which statement about Population distribution in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Population distribution in Eastern Africa.
   B. Explain Population distribution in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Population distribution in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Population distribution in Eastern Africa as rumours only.

7. Which statement about Wildlife and Tourism in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Wildlife and Tourism in Eastern Africa as rumours only.
   B. Explain Wildlife and Tourism in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Wildlife and Tourism in Eastern Africa.
   D. Say Wildlife and Tourism in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.

8. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Littering in markets
   B. Avoiding all community work
   C. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   D. Destroying road signs

9. Which statement about Language groups in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Language groups in Eastern Africa as rumours only.
   B. Say Language groups in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Language groups in Eastern Africa.
   D. Explain Language groups in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

10. Which statement about Fishing in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Fishing in Eastern Africa.
   B. Treat Fishing in Eastern Africa as rumours only.
   C. Explain Fishing in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Fishing in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.

11. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Avoid saving forever
   B. Hide all money underground
   C. Plan income and spending wisely
   D. Ignore prices in shops

12. Which statement about Culture and Social Organisation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Culture and Social Organisation.
   B. Say Culture and Social Organisation never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Culture and Social Organisation as rumours only.
   D. Explain Culture and Social Organisation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Government Revenue and Expenditure and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Main physical features in Eastern Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Climatic regions in Eastern Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
